title: Excellent Habit Tracker with annoying Bug
body:
Maybe the most important features of ShineDay are it’s widgets. Being able to “check off” completed habits without opening the app, combined with it’s unique colorful design does allows for the small, unobstructed dopamine kick one needs to keep trying and trying.

Sadly this functionality has encountered a bug and is not working properly, displaying “Unable to load” instead of the uncompleted habits (iPhone6S). 
I don’t know if I have too many habits or something, but it would be nice if this bug could be fixed.

Sadly the feedback functionality is lacking too, as are my Chinese language skills, thus being forced to give my feedback publicly as review.
author: Logichris
